title: Ack & Brunt
extract:
The Ack & Brunt is an axe & shield set used by Tyl Regor that boasts a high critical hit chance in exchange for a low attack speed. It also has the unique ability to absorb elemental attacks on block to empower the weapon's next attack.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Blocking elemental damage attacks stores a charge that grants +17.5% of the absorbed elemental damage to the next attack. The charge can stack up to 4 times before being consumed.
Can use the Ack & Brunt-exclusive  Electromagnetic Shielding mod.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Eleventh Storm,  Final Harbinger and  Last Herald stance.

Acquisition
The Ack & Brunt's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Notes
Blocking elemental damage attacks creates a stack that increases the damage of the next attack by 17.5% stacks. The effect can stack up to 4 times before being consumed, increasing the damage up to 70%.
The damage bonus increases additively with elemental mods, which can also combine with elemental mods from the weapon to became a combined elements. For example, if your Ack & Brunt is modded with  Electricity damage (e.g.  Shocking Touch), blocking  Heat damage from a Flameblade's  Twin Basolk will combine it into  Radiation damage on the next attack.
Elemental damage taken by nearby allies via  Electromagnetic Shielding can be converted to stacks.

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Ack & Brunt Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Ack & Brunt with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Ack & Brunt Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Dracroots, and 300  Ariette Scales.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by building Melee Combo to 6x, then using a Heavy Attack. Once activated, the Incarnon form lasts for 180 seconds.
Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, Incarnon Form is removed upon death.

Evolutions

Tips
 Final Harbinger can offset the Ack & Brunt's low attack speed with its quick combos.
Using the Ack & Brunt with  Final Harbinger,  Blood Rush and/or Gladiator Mods allows players to quickly gather hits for the Combo Counter, rapidly boosting the Ack & Brunt's critical chance.
Absorbing enemy attacks allows players to almost double the amount of damage they can deal.
This is useful when focusing on taking down heavy units in a crowd.
Do note however that stacks are expended if an enemy melee attack is parried.
(Corrupted) Bombard rockets can add up to two stacks of elemental damage, allowing players to collect stacks faster.

Trivia
This is the weapon of choice for Tyl Regor following Update 17.0 (2015-07-31), though instead of holding the weapon, Tyl Regor is able to attach the axe and shield to the ends of his cybernetic limbs in place of his  Knux hands. Regor, however, explicitly refers to Ack as a gavel.
Before Update 17.0 (2015-07-31), his weapon of choice was the  Skana.
Tyl Regor uses a different design for the shield, as it is normally part of his helmet/headdress (or perhaps vice-versa). The Tenno version presumably adapts the shield to collapse so that it does not take up as much room when stowed.
The Grineer text on the inner part of the shield translates to "MEAT PROTECTION".

Bugs
When in its Incarnon form, the shield will never leave the players hand during stances that normally throw the shield.
